title: Certify zero four-shear headroom in twelve PR4470 receiver windows (no new kappa)
body:
## Upstream publication and complete scope

Publishes [fork PR #18](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/pull/18), preserving exact verified head `55b8d34c82fc4df6499c5037e156db6e990b96fe`. Publication comparison was refreshed against upstream `f626db5c3a3d781d8f7695038776c621651f75e1` on 22 October 2026: **17 changed files, 5 contribution commits**. The scientific package is isolated in its own directory, but the complete upstream diff also carries the shared historical-replay/source-role and navigation/CI repairs from its preparation base, plus the base documentation. Shared repair bytes overlap across fork #14–#18 and must be reconciled once; they are not independent scientific contributions. All five research heads have successful exact-head fork workflows. Opening this PR is not a new scientific replay, upstream CI pass, merge or theorem acceptance. Scientific source pins, attribution and scope limitations are retained.

Related construction replay: [upstream #4543](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4543), originally fork #15. This ceiling uses a separate implementation and does not add overlapping window gains.

---

## Change and mathematical scope

Assignment B independently certifies **zero optimistic paid-moment headroom in all twelve tested PR4470 receiver windows** at C=0.00302015. It covers every word of at most four unit shears on the three persistent fields with the same logical endpoint and fixed entrance/exit contract. No new kappa, global ceiling or physical supplier admission.

For each of four sign choices, the exact integer-matrix census enumerates 22,621 words and finds 84 endpoint matches: two of length two, two of length three and eighty of length four. Forward mandatory spans and backward permissible intersections give a favourable dimension relaxation containing every actual monotone frame path. Every movement and terminal gap remains charged. The best gain upper bound is exactly zero in all twelve windows, even before enforcing all simultaneous incidence constraints. Ten windows have one relaxed profile; two have four, none improving.

This strengthens [fork PR15](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/pull/15)'s three-shear negative result through a separately implemented enumeration, relaxation and interval calculation. PR15's acceptance code is not imported. The original path is admitted, so zero is attained by the incumbent. The source contains 128 eligible pairs, but this result covers only the first twelve, all in phase B. Individual results cannot be added across overlapping windows.

## Task and overlap

Canonical base `f9f85c1e4fa1e955ff39f10fca447e3e2a4e4adc`, PR4470 head `b9a13c1673e0e9697de410de16e8bbf3207a7363`, priority revision 7. Seven exact source files are authenticated before the inherited constructor emits the data. TASK.json records the refined independent-moment assignment and complete original card.

PR4121 concerns older T360 sources; #4091's old fixed-inventory ceiling is not applied outside its hypotheses. The final refresh also located PR4535's higher critical-root conditional transfer and PR4534/4539's noncommuting-controller work. Those change future comparison points or available interfaces, not the frozen twelve-window result. Searches were targeted, not exhaustive overlap pagination or novelty proof. The historical baseline helper was not run.

The scientific contribution remains pinned to its isolated preparation base. This upstream submission preserves the exact verified head; no merge or selected-frontier change is requested.

## Validation

The first full source-bound workflow [39724143539](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39724143539) passed at `dce9576ec448af52009ec13a4f8c1a740fb4a8d8`, on Ubuntu and CPython 3.12.15, standard library only. Metadata/source checks, all twelve ceilings, optimised controls and preservation of committed inputs passed. RESULT.json retains every emitted field. A separate local check using the observed boundary fixtures reproduces the ceiling rows, but is not claimed as another fresh source extraction.

Publication head is `55b8d34c82fc4df6499c5037e156db6e990b96fe`; its complete rerun is [39726182814](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39726182814). Read that exact-head check for final status. The outcome enum was corrected to `negative-result` without changing science.

The registered `replay.py` authenticates the unchanged scientific engine and compares every field in canonical JSON form, addressing integer rank keys versus JSON string keys. Six controls reject altered values/types, reordered arrays and missing/extra fields. It never rewrites evidence or uses the authoring path. Original controls include all four scalar censuses, 68 actual small geometric paths, required exits, incompatible exits and exact equal-profile handling.

```sh
python -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/four-shear-window-ceilings
python -I -O -B research/four-shear-window-ceilings/verify.py --self-test
```

No new physical lowering, full native endpoint, compiler/outer admission, global optimisation, selected cold replay or optional source-history preflight was performed. No conclusion about longer/nonadjacent/joint rewrites, extra fields, nonunit coefficients or the other 116 windows follows.

## Credit

Credit zxv's receiver-sharing and productive-helper work, Cinna Davis's PR4470, Jacob Alan Sussman, GamingPuzzled's older census and retained native/Clifford/geometry/outer contributors. Prepared for Chris R / Clear1nsight with substantial OpenAI assistance, Apache-2.0. Separate implementations in one session are not independently launched agents, human review or formal acceptance.

## Open next questions

Change the length cap, coefficients, adjacency, owned-field allowance or producer/consumer boundary explicitly before reopening this domain. First derive the complete optimistic cost model and test a structurally justified window. A positive relaxed profile in a changed model would still require a geometric realisation and physical/consumer validation. Do not reseed these twelve fixed cases or sum overlapping gains. README.md, TASK.json and the public handoff preserve the scoped exclusion.
